moment.title: PATCH PIECE
lines: You are carrying a piece. Click a slag block within reach to fuse it in for 4 RAM. One use, then it is gone.
Arms land exactly as held, never rotating once placed. Fit it to the wall you cannot route around, not the first slag you see.

label.why: The mount above inserts the corrected patch-cell-use-cost panel right after the shipped patch-cell-use line; this label then deletes that shipped line outright, in the same file, right after the insert runs. Only the corrected panel's Teach mount survives, so a player can never land on the old panel that still says 2 RAM after dismissing the corrected one. The shipped patch-cell-use entry stays in teaching.ts but is now unreachable: nothing mounts it, so it is never eligible and never shown.

claims.resolves: PLACE_COST = 4, the RAM charged when a patch piece is fused into a slag block mid dive.
